description: Sewn goods by Bits and Bobyns and turned wood by The Yorkshire Garage, sold together as Sticks & Giggles.

hero.title: Made in West Yorkshire by two independent crafters.
hero.intro: Sticks & Giggles is the shared stall of Bits and Bobyns and The Yorkshire Garage. Robyn works with fabric and Aiden turns wood.

introduction.title: Two makers sharing one stall.
introduction.body: Robyn makes sewn goods as Bits and Bobyns. Aiden makes turned wooden pieces in The Yorkshire Garage. We set up Sticks & Giggles so we could take both ranges to markets together. The dark wood and colourful fabrics look good side by side, so we let each bring out the best in the other.

brands.name: Bits and Bobyns
brands.description: Robyn makes cushions, plushies, tea towels and decorations under the name Bits and Bobyns.

brands.name: The Yorkshire Garage
brands.description: Aiden turns pens, bowls and other useful wooden pieces in his Yorkshire garage.
